claim: CloudFront embedded POPs are deployed directly in ISP and MNO networks, in the last mile, unlike CloudFront POPs that are deployed within the AWS network. Embedded POPs are custom built to deliver large scale live-streaming events, video-on-demand (VOD) and game downloads.

evidence.quote: These embedded POPs are owned and operated by Amazon and deployed in the last mile of the ISP/MNO networks to avoid capacity bottlenecks in congested networks that connect end viewers to content sources, improving performance.
CloudFront embedded POPs are deployed directly in ISP and MNO networks, unlike CloudFront POPs that are deployed within the AWS network.
Embedded POPs are custom built to deliver large scale live-streaming events, video-on-demand (VOD), and game downloads.
